(rule! (let ((dummy 0))
  (define (relay-colors-reading grid)
    (remove-duplicates
     (filter (lambda (v) (not (= v 0)))
             (map (lambda (p) (at grid (first p) (second p)))
                  (grid-positions grid)))))
  (define (canonical-fill grid)
    (for*/fold ((out grid))
               ((color (in-list (relay-colors-reading grid)))
                (diag (in-range (+ (rows grid) (cols grid)))))
      (let ((cells
             (filter
              (lambda (p)
                (and (= (at grid (first p) (second p)) color)
                     (= (+ (first p) (second p)) diag)))
              (grid-positions grid))))
        (if (>= (length cells) 2)
            (let ((r0 (apply min (map first cells)))
                  (r1 (apply max (map first cells))))
              (for/fold ((acc out)) ((r (in-range r0 (+ r1 1))))
                (let ((c (- diag r)))
                  (if (in-bounds? r c (rows grid) (cols grid))
                      (set-cell acc r c color)
                      acc))))
            out))))
  (define (cardinal-neighbors p h w)
    (let ((r (first p)) (c (second p)))
      (filter
       (lambda (q) (in-bounds? (first q) (second q) h w))
       (list (list (- r 1) c) (list (+ r 1) c)
             (list r (- c 1)) (list r (+ c 1))))))
  (define (newly-filled-neighbors original filled relay)
    (filter
     (lambda (p)
       (and (= (at original (first p) (second p)) 0)
            (not (= (at filled (first p) (second p)) 0))))
     (cardinal-neighbors relay (rows original) (cols original))))
  (let* ((filled (canonical-fill g))
         (relays
          (filter
           (lambda (p)
             (and (= (at g (first p) (second p)) 8)
                  (= (length (newly-filled-neighbors g filled p)) 1)))
           (grid-positions g))))
    (if (= (length relays) 1)
        (let* ((relay (first relays))
               (neighbor (first (newly-filled-neighbors g filled relay)))
               (rr (first relay)) (rc (second relay))
               (nr (first neighbor)) (nc (second neighbor))
               (color (at filled nr nc))
               (dr (- rr nr)) (dc (- rc nc))
               (recolored (set-cell filled rr rc color)))
          (let loop ((out recolored) (r (+ rr dr)) (c (+ rc dc)))
            (if (and (in-bounds? r c (rows g) (cols g))
                     (= (at filled r c) 0))
                (loop (set-cell out r c color) (+ r dr) (+ c dc))
                out)))
        filled))))
